scenes.heading: MOONKATTY NEWS
scenes.text: This is MOONKATTY NEWS. Three world stories, each checked against at least two independent sources.

scenes.heading: Guardian · CBS
scenes.text: The Guardian reports: Alberta voters overwhelmingly reject plan to leave Canada in referendum. CBS News reports: Voters reject separation of Alberta from Canada in referendum.

scenes.heading: NPR · ABC
scenes.text: NPR reports: Nigeria confirms an Ebola case in Abuja as a woman arriving from Uganda tests positive. ABC News reports: Nigeria confirms Ebola case in Abuja as woman who arrived from Uganda tests positive.

scenes.heading: BBC · Guardian
scenes.text: BBC News reports: UK to deploy jets to defend Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks. The Guardian reports: UK to deploy fighter jets to protect Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks.

scenes.heading: Sources
scenes.text: These accounts come from the sources named in this edition. This edition is waiting for approval and has not been published.
